item.title: Intel's Clear Linux Website No Longer Online
item.description: Last July Intel sadly ended their Clear Linux distribution amid cost-cutting measures at the company. Clear Linux for a decade served at the forefront of Linux performance innovations and was consistently the fastest out-of-the-box Linux x86_64 distribution until Intel ended the Linux distribution without any advanced notice for its users. GNU Hurd 64-bit support is now said to be ready but SMP support for multiple processor cores and the like remain still in development...
